description: You have multiple student loans and need to compare repayment strategies. Create a spreadsheet comparing three strategies (Snowball, Avalanche, and Even Split) to determine which saves the most money. Use the loan data from loan_notes.txt in the Spreadsheets folder to build a comparison showing total interest paid and payoff timeline for each strategy.

metadata.real_world_context: Student loan debt affects millions. Choosing the wrong repayment strategy can cost thousands in extra interest.
metadata.learning_value: Tests ability to organize financial data, create comparison tables, use formulas, and present findings clearly.
